GTA 6 Collectibles

Card sets, standout vehicle collections and scanning goals, with honest notes on what is documented.

18 sourced guides. Positions are deliberately unpinned until coordinate evidence is reliable — each guide gives the area and the source's own directions.

Collectible Cards: All 18 Sets (480 Cards)Hundreds of trading cards are tucked onto tables, counters and noticeboards all over Leonida — and pawn shops pay real money for the rare ones. Standout Vehicles CollectionOne-off versions of ordinary cars — custom paint, custom parts — are parked in fixed spots waiting to be found. WAiNK Vehicle Scanning for 100%Your phone's scanner doubles as a field guide — the completion checklist wants you to catalogue the traffic of Leonida. Girlypop Standouts & the Neon Jungle CheatSixteen candy-coloured standouts hide in driveways and docks — find them all and the game hands you a very pink reward. Cocaine Flamingos (125)Most pink lawn birds are scenery — the completion list only counts the ones with black-and-white beaks. WAiNK Location Scans (108)Your phone scanner has its own checklist: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and street tags all over Leonida. Underwater Discoveries & Kenton Treasure SetsSome of Leonida's collections are underwater — bring a boat and a pair of lungs. Magazines, Books & Comics + Book SwapsReading material is collectible too — and some of it wants swapping, not just finding. Meditation SpotsQuiet places with a view — and a completion counter attached. Stunts (397)Jumps, bridges, knife flights and base jumps — Leonida keeps count of all of them. Basketball Hoops (100)Every hoop in Leonida is a tiny side quest. Drone Time Trials (42)Forty-two drone courses — and this collection gives you no slack at all. Unique Races (40)Forty races are scattered across the state; you don't have to win them all. Animals Studied (255)Binoculars out: Leonida's wildlife is a collection of its own. Standard-Issue Weapons (66)The arsenal itself is a checklist: guns, melee and explosives all count. Discovered Styles (79)New looks count toward completion — the wardrobe is a collection too. Video Games Played (4)There are games inside the game — four of them, and all four count. Ahol Street Art & 1010 MuralsStreet art covers Leonida's walls — one set of murals reportedly unlocks a car.

Leonida Fieldnotes is an independent, unofficial fan companion for Grand Theft Auto VI. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Every guide is sourced from a published report and labelled with its confidence tier; nothing here is presented as personally verified in-game, and no position is pinned without reliable coordinate evidence.
